chain.title: First power from heat
chain.desc: Place a Heat Generator and use its active fuel supply or passive heat setup. Connect it to a machine or buffer and watch the actual output before adding more consumers.

chain.title: Assemble solar components
chain.desc: Craft solar panels for the sunlight-powered generator branch. Solar production depends on the environment, so keep another source or a charged buffer for downtime.

chain.title: Power while the sun shines
chain.desc: Install a Solar Generator with open sky. Solar, wind, and fuel generation are alternative early paths; you do not need every type to run a workshop.

chain.title: Harness the wind
chain.desc: Place a Wind Generator with clear space and route its energy to your base. Check local output at the chosen height instead of assuming a fixed rate across packs.

chain.title: Put organic fuel to work
chain.desc: Feed a Bio-Generator with bio fuel from a Mekanism Crusher. Automate a renewable crop source if this will be your main workshop supply.

chain.title: Turn a gas supply into power
chain.desc: Feed a supported fuel gas and energy output connection. Ethylene can support a larger factory, but it needs the complete Mekanism production chain and a steady organic supply.

chain.title: Expand the solar branch
chain.desc: Upgrade the solar installation and provide room for its structure. Buffer the daytime production so machines can finish their work after dark.

chain.title: Design an industrial turbine
chain.desc: Plan the complete turbine using Mekanism's multiblock guide. It converts supplied steam into energy; fission is one possible steam source, not a required recipe dependency.

chain.title: The central shaft
chain.desc: Stack the rotors in the turbine's center and fit blades to match the selected size. Check the allowed dimensions before filling the outer shell.

chain.title: Give the rotor working area
chain.desc: Fit turbine blades and compare the supported steam flow with your source. Extra casing alone does not make a turbine productive.

chain.title: Join rotor and generator
chain.desc: Place the Rotational Complex above the rotor as shown in the structure guide. Keep space above it for electromagnetic coils and steam-handling parts.

chain.title: Convert rotation into energy
chain.desc: Arrange electromagnetic coils for the installed blades. Balance the generator section with the rotor rather than adding coils without a matching turbine capacity.

chain.title: Connect the steam circuit
chain.desc: Use turbine valves for the required input and output connections. Check the completed turbine's interface before starting a high-throughput steam source.

chain.title: Recover cooling water
chain.desc: Add condensers where the guide specifies and return the recovered water to your cooling circuit. Monitor the return rate under load; a closed loop still needs enough capacity.

chain.title: Start a separate fission project
chain.desc: Plan a complete fission reactor, a coolant supply, steam handling, and radioactive waste storage before fueling it. Fission is optional for early power and industrial turbines.

chain.title: Arrange the fuel columns
chain.desc: Place fuel assemblies within the reactor's permitted layout. Leave room for coolant and use the reactor guide to determine valid dimensions and control-rod placement.

chain.title: Control each fuel column
chain.desc: Fit the required control-rod assemblies above fuel columns. Complete the shell and verify the reactor forms before preparing fuel or raising the burn rate.

chain.title: Separate fuel, coolant, and waste
chain.desc: Configure reactor ports for each resource. Build the Mekanism fissile-fuel chain and radiation-safe waste route before operation, then begin at a low burn rate with coolant monitoring.

chain.title: Inspect the reactor shell
chain.desc: Use Reactor Glass where the multiblock permits it. A clear view helps inspection, but the controller's coolant, heat, and damage readings determine whether operation is safe.

chain.title: Plan a fusion facility
chain.desc: Start the fusion branch with its frame and complete structure plan. It requires deuterium and tritium production, startup fuel, laser ignition, and significant supporting machinery.

chain.title: Control fusion injection
chain.desc: Add the controller and required ports. Prepare independent deuterium and tritium supplies, then review injection settings before attempting ignition.

chain.title: Prepare the ignition fuel
chain.desc: Infuse gold dust with carbon to make a Hohlraum, then fill it with fusion fuel as directed by the reactor guide. This container can be prepared early, but an empty Hohlraum cannot start the reactor.

chain.title: Deliver the ignition pulse
chain.desc: Build the laser and energy-storage setup, aiming through the Laser Focus Matrix. Confirm the fueled Hohlraum and gas supplies before sending the startup pulse.

chain.title: Recharge your suit in daylight
chain.desc: Install a Solar Recharging Unit in compatible MekaSuit equipment using the Modification Station. This equipment upgrade needs Mekanism's suit progression, not a fusion reactor.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
limits: Reactor and turbine component tasks do not detect a formed or safely operating multiblock.
Mekanism core provides fuels, waste processing, lasers, and MekaSuit equipment.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
